hook.text: A video shows a president declaring war. His lips move perfectly. His voice is exact. The video is entirely fake.

buildup.text: Deepfakes use AI to generate realistic video and audio. The technology improves every month and costs drop.

discovery.text: In 2023, a deepfake of a CEO's voice tricked an employee into wiring $25 million. Seeing isn't believing anymore.

twist.text: The real threat isn't fake videos believed. It's real videos dismissed. 'That could be a deepfake' kills truth.

climax.text: Detection tools exist but lag behind creation tools. The arms race favors fakers. Verification can't keep pace.

punchline.text: When anything can be faked, nothing can be trusted.

quiz.question: What is the broader societal threat of deepfakes beyond deception?
options: People dismiss real evidence as potentially fake
